player_0.content: New plan: I failed because my clue "holding shares" directly used the related word "share," which violates rule (b) and causes an immediate loss. Next time, I will strictly avoid naming the related words ("partner," "share," "concerned") or their obvious derivatives. Instead, I will focus on the core concept of "having a stake" or "influence" using synonyms like "ownership," "equity," or "voting power" without explicitly mentioning the forbidden terms. For example, I would say: "CLUE: Someone who has a financial stake and voting rights in a business."
